_comment: Post-release verification (AGENTS.md §29 PROPOSED; operator 2026-10-25 'it's deployed, tested'). Read by scripts/lib/post_release_tester.py only. After every release (train or manual, detected from the deploy receipt history) the tester runs the post-promote API checks at once (health ok, /v3/cio 200, served BUILD_SHA == released SHA, release wrapper preflight when admitted), then a light browser sweep through scripts/site_sweep.sh (top routes, 412/390 viewports, 'broken' detectors only) — never 04:00-16:15 ET on a weekday (§28.8) and never above the memory gate; a deferred sweep runs at the first allowed tick. A nightly full sweep runs at nightly_at ET when memory allows. GET only, one request at a time. Changed only by reviewed PR.
